title: Dominic and the Lantern
author: Kestrel Amberdale
blurb: Rosalind Underhill, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
